newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares reopen slowly, Unibanka dominates.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares reopen slowly, Unibanka dominates.

text.p: The Latvian bourse saw a slow reopening of trade on Thursday, with trade in Unibanka dominating.

Total turnover rose to 51,492 lats against 14,640 on December 27. Unibanka on the official list was the most actively traded with turnover in the share totalling 43,945 lats as it closed at 2.35 lats compared to 2.40.
Jekabpils Sugar continued up, climbing to 0.32 lats versus 0.28 as it traded 1,984 lats.
Activity on the secondary market was low, except for Daugavpils Chain maker, turning over shares worth 994 lats as its price increased slightly to 1.13 lats against 1.11.

Another two official list shares, Riga Transport Fleet and Staburadze confectionery, were unchanged at 0.99 lats and 2.10 lats, respectively. Staburadze turned over 724 lats and trade in Transport Fleet was also relatively busy at 522 lats.
